newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Low rate regime from Australian budget - Costello.
newsitem.headline: Low rate regime from Australian budget - Costello.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Tuesday the 1997/98 budget which he announced earlier promised a much lower regime of interest rates.
"By turning the budget deficit into a surplus we're getting a much lower interest rate regime," Costello told Network Ten television.
Costello had earlier forecast an underlying budget deficit of A$3.9 billion for 1997/98.
By June 1998, that deficit will have become a surplus of A$1.6 billion, and will increase further to a surplus of A$5.4 billion in 1999/00.
Interest rates are set by the Reserve Bank of Australia, which lowered the official cash rate on three occasions last year to its current level of 6.00 percent.
